headline: First reading of seven school policies covering executive sessions, voting, consent agenda, and public comment.
summary: A first review of the policies may lead to a vote. Recess, tutoring, and school reports are also on the list, along with an executive session on the superintendent's evaluation.
items: Public input, up to 3 minutes per speaker

location: The Green Ladle, 400 Bartlett St, Lewiston
plain_text:
** AGENDA** 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING SCHEDULED FOR MONDAY, NOVEMBER 16, 2026 
AT THE GREEN LADLE, 400 BARTLETT ST, LEWISTON 
Note:  
*A review of all general session meetings can be located at www.lewistonpublicschools.org or copies can be requested at a cost of 10 
cents per page.   
**This Agenda includes estimated time for each agenda item which is being used only as a guide to keep the meeting on schedule. 
***Video Notice: This meeting is being recorded and can be viewed on the internet from a link at www.lewistonpublicschools.org 
 
1. Call meeting to order on or about 5:30 pm until approximately 8:30. Pledge of Allegiance. 
 
2. School Committee Member Introductions. 
 
3. Consent Agenda: (a) Minutes (b) Personnel (c) Policies 
i. BEDA – Notification of School Committee Members 
ii. BEDC – Quorum 
iii. BEDFA – Abstentions 
iv. BEDG - Minutes 
 
4. Public Input: (Note: Members of the public may address the School Committee for up to 3 minutes on non-agenda 
items now and on agenda items later. Speakers must adhere to our public comment policy (BEDH), which is 
available in the back of the room or on the LPS website. These meetings exist to conduct school committee business. 
The purpose of public comment is to share thoughts on school and educational matters. Committee members and 
school staff will not reply during this time. Comments must be directed to the Chair and be civil. By law, comments 
may not pertain to specific staff or students; comments about individuals must be directed privately to the 
appropriate LPS staff. Student privacy must be maintained. The public comment period is 30 minutes unless 
extended due to unusual circumstances. Priority goes to Lewiston residents and parents, students, or employees of 
LPS. Before starting, please state your name, town/city of residence, and affiliation to LPS. 
 
5. To receive Lewiston Public Schools recognition. 
 
6. To receive rotating school reports – Lewiston Middle School, Farwell Elementary School and McMahon Elementary 
School. 
 
7. To review recess and outdoor opportunities. 
 
8. Targeted Tutoring Efforts. 
 
9. To review and potentially vote on the 1st read of the following policies: 
a. BEC – Executive Sessions 
b. BEC-R– Executive Session Procedure 
c. BEDB-R - Agenda Format 
d. BEDBA - Consent Agenda 
e. BEDD – Rules of Order 
f. BEDF – Voting Method 
g. BEDH – Public Comment at School Committee Meetings
10. Report from School Committee Chair. 
 
11. Report from School Superintendent. 
 
12. Report from the City Council Rep. 
 
13. Updates from School Committee Subcommittees. 
 
14. School Committee Community Announcements.  
 
15. Future agenda items. 
 
16. To enter into executive session to discuss a personnel matter in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(A). 
 
17. To enter into executive session in accordance with 1 M.R.S.A. §405(6)(A) to conduct a discussion regarding the 
Evaluation of Superintendent. 
 
18. Adjourn. 
 
 
ADA Notice: This school district will accommodate members of the public with special needs to participate fully in this 
meeting. Please contact Executive Assistant Cheryl Cornelio (795-4100, Ext.4002) if you have such needs.
